context: Two friends chat at the cafe about starting something new
purpose: Teach: うっかり/おもい/おなか/つづく/とれる/はじめる/はたして/ましてや

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイさん、おなかすいてない？今から新しいスコーンを焼きはじめるところなの。
lines.en: Mei, aren't you hungry? I'm about to start baking a new scone right now.
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone with friendly barista energy and quiet pride in her new bake.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: わあ、うれしい！実はね、私もちょっとおもい話があって、相談したくて来たの。
lines.en: Oh, how lovely! Actually, I have a kind of heavy thing on my mind, and I came to talk.
lines.style: Dreamy and a bit hesitant, voice trailing softly with romantic uncertainty and hope.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: おもい話？へえ、めずらしいね。コーヒー入れるから、ゆっくり話してよ。
lines.en: A heavy talk? Wow, that's unusual for you. I'll pour coffee, so take your time.
lines.style: Curious and gentle, voice softening with care as she reaches for the kettle.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 陶芸教室、はじめてみようかなって。でもうっかり申込書をなくしちゃって…
lines.en: I was thinking of starting a pottery class. But I carelessly lost the application form...
lines.style: Soft, slightly embarrassed laugh, voice fading into self-deprecating sweetness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あはは、メイさんらしい。人気の教室だから、枠がとれるうちに動いたほうがいいよ。
lines.en: Haha, that's so like you. It's a popular class, so move while spots can still be taken.
lines.style: Affectionate teasing, laughing warmly like an older sister giving a gentle push.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん…でも私、趣味が長くつづくことが少ないタイプで。はたして続けられるのかな…
lines.en: Yeah... but I'm the type whose hobbies don't last. I really wonder if I can keep at it...
lines.style: Wistful and introspective, voice quiet with self-doubt and longing for change.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 私もカフェ開いたとき、毎日続くか不安だった。ましてや一人だったし、本当に怖かったよ。
lines.en: When I opened the cafe, I worried daily if I could keep going. Let alone alone, it was scary.
lines.style: Gentle and confiding, voice lowering to share genuine vulnerability across the counter.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: アオイさんでも怖かったんだ…なんか心が軽くなった。明日、申し込みに行ってくる！
lines.en: Even you were scared... somehow my heart feels lighter. Tomorrow, I'll go sign up!
lines.style: Voice brightening with sudden resolve, romantic determination warming her tone gently.
